Healthy Black Forest Baked Oatmeal
By: Munchin with Mu...
Published: Sunday, February 12, 2012 - 8:47am

Ingredients




1 cup rolled oats (not instant)
½ cup applesauce
½ cup fat free milk (or dairy free milk, to make vegan)
¾ cup pitted cherries (fresh or frozen)
½ Tsp. vanilla extract
¼ cup chocolate chips
1 Tbsp. chia seeds
1 Tbsp. cocoa powder

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 375 2 Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. 3 Spray a muffin tin with cooking oil. Fill the tin to the top with oats. It should make about six – eight oatmeal cakes. 4 Bake uncovered for 20 minutes. For a light crust, broil for an additional 3-5 minutes until lightly browned. 5 Serve on it’s own or with fresh fruit, yogurt, or milk.

About

The perfect healthy breakfast for valentines day. They're portable too, all the more reason to enjoy breakfast in bed! (vegan)
